name: What is an attached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: An attached Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) is a secondary housing unit that is physically connected to the primary residence. This can include converting an existing garage, adding a new extension to the home, or building a unit directly connected through a shared wall. Attached ADUs typically share utilities and sometimes entryways with the main house, but they function as independent living spaces with their own kitchen, bathroom, and sleeping area.
acceptedAnswer.description: An attached ADU is a secondary living unit built as an addition to or conversion of a space connected to the main house.
